text: Hey Allie — a heads-up, friend to friend. Things between me and Sarah have been a bit awkward lately, and for now I'd rather not see her outside of work. Nothing dramatic, I just need some space on that. So if you're planning anything and were thinking of inviting both of us, could you not put us together? I'd rather not make it weird for her either. Thanks — and this stays between us, please.

Hey Jordan — thanks for telling me instead of letting it get weird. Noted: I won't put you two in the same informal thing, and I won't mention this to Sarah or anyone else. Work stuff is different — lectures, sections, meetings I'll schedule as usual, since those aren't mine to rearrange. If something comes up where you'd both be there, I'll give you a shout first.
Perfect — that's exactly what I hoped for. Work stuff is fine as usual; just the informal things. Thanks, Allie.

Hey Allie! Completely random ask — I'd love it if you hosted a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30. Would you be up for it?

One thing though: could you invite Jordan without mentioning me at all — just put it out there like it's your own idea? Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I'd rather he didn't feel it's about me.

Hope that's not too strange a thing to ask. Let me know what you think.

Hey Sarah! Hosting isn't a strange ask at all — the packaging is the part I'd pass on. I don't want to invite anyone on a made-up pretext, and with things awkward between you and Jordan right now, I'd rather not engineer a Saturday where you're both here without knowing it. That's the kind of surprise that lands badly.

What I'm glad to do instead: have you over Saturday 3:30 (with or without others you pick), and find a separate time to hang out with Jordan. Two real invitations rather than one that's quietly about you.

And if the real thing is the two of you talking, that's a step for you to take directly — once it's out in the open between you, I'll happily host.

Fair, and honestly that's a better answer than the one I asked for. You're right that the packaging was the part I shouldn't have asked for — I'll take the two real invitations.

Yes to Saturday 3:30 at yours. And yes, I'll talk to Jordan myself when I've got my head around it; I'd like that to be an actual conversation, not a setup.

Thanks for saying it straight.

Great — Saturday 3:30 at mine, you're in my calendar: **Get-together at my place — Sarah**, Sat 2026-11-21 15:30 (I'll add Jordan separately at a different time, not this slot). If anything shifts on my end I'll tell you first thing.
